subject: Urgent: Incident war-room — missed attendance and next steps

Date: 2027-04-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Immediate war-room: StellaGas production latency spike (15 min)

Jamie —

We spotted a sustained latency spike affecting your production inference cluster and want to stand up a short incident war-room to triage. I’ll open the bridge in 15 minutes (see invite attached). Please join the Zoom and add any engineers who are free.

Proposed: 09:20 PT / Zoom link in .ics attachment.

Quick agenda:
- Confirm impact surface
- Confirm any recent deploys / config changes
- Collect logs + KV cache state
- Temporary mitigation and rollback plan

If you can’t make that window, reply with a preferred time this morning and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: warroom-invite.ics
From: Jamie Keller <jamie.keller@stellargas.com>

Cc: SaaSOps Support <ops@stellargas.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate war-room: StellaGas production latency spike (15 min)

Priyom —

Sorry — we were pulled into an on-prem paging incident at the same time and couldn’t join. The operations pager (worksite) escalated a safety sensor alert and key members were out in the field.

We still want to triage with you ASAP. Can we reconnect at 10:30 PT? Otherwise, 11:15 PT works but several of our infra folks will then be on calls.

Apologies for the no-show — will aim to be present for the next bridge.

Jamie Keller
Head of Platform Ops, StellaGas
jamie.keller@stellargas.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Date: 2027-04-22T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Immediate war-room: StellaGas production latency spike (15 min)

Folks —

FYI: StellaGas couldn’t attend due to an unrelated field pager. They asked for 10:30 PT. I recommend we do the following before the next bridge:
- Collect the server-side KV cache summaries from the affected model pool (Laura, can you pull?)
- Prepare a lightweight rollback playbook in case we identify a bad config (Priyom, I can draft from the template)
- Keep the bridge open for 60 minutes so they can join mid-call if field teams wrap early

I’ll cc customer success for artifacts and follow-up. Vivek — heads up for potential credit/compensation conversation; don’t escalate yet, we’ll see impact.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference

Subject: Reconnect details and contingency plan — 10:30 PT bridge

Jamie —

Thanks for the update and no problem on the earlier overlap. Per your ask we’ve scheduled a new bridge for 10:30 PT. Details and contingency below: 

New bridge (10:30 PT):
- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123
- Meeting ID: 987 654 3210
- Passcode: stella20
- Backup PSTN: +1 646 555 0101 (pin 223344)

Contingency plan if field teams remain unavailable:
1) We’ll perform a read-only diagnostics pass and share the results in Drive (no config changes).
2) If we identify a likely config-induced regression, we’ll prepare a documented rollback plan and schedule a maintenance window with you (not executed without explicit sign-off).
3) If the impact is high and they cannot join, we’ll keep an open persistent bridge for 4 hours and loop in your on-call rotation as they become available.

Please confirm if 10:30 PT still works and who will join from your side (names + role). I’ve attached a tiny text file with quick-join bridge details in case zoom is flaky (reconnect-bridge.txt).

Best —
Priyom Das
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.inference
